field_edits.updated_text: Bone mineralization is within normal limits. No erosive osseous changes or aggressive bone lesion is identified. No acute fracture or focal osseous lesion.

Mild degenerative osteoarthrosis involving the first carpometacarpal (CMC) joint with mild joint space narrowing and small marginal osteophytes. Minimal scattered degenerative changes in the interphalangeal joints. Joint spaces are otherwise preserved. No dislocation.
Mild soft tissue swelling is present about the hand. No radiopaque foreign body is identified.

impression:
1. Mild degenerative osteoarthrosis of the first carpometacarpal joint with mild joint space narrowing and marginal osteophytes, and minimal scattered interphalangeal degenerative changes.
2. Mild soft tissue swelling of the hand.
3. No acute fracture or dislocation.
